request.action_description: ONE grounded FRONT PUSH KICK (teep), then recover. Start in compact two-hand fighting guard. Chamber ONE knee high directly in front of the abdomen; keep the other supporting foot planted at a fixed ground point. Drive hips slightly forward and extend the raised leg STRAIGHT FORWARD at mid-torso height. Show the sole/front pad of the bare tiger foot clearly outside the torso silhouette at full extension. Briefly hold this unmistakable straight-leg contact pose. Re-chamber the same knee and set the kicking foot down, finishing in the starting guard. Opposite hand stays near the cheek. Chest may lean back slightly. One kick only, no roundhouse, no airborne jump, no knee strike, no rotating away, no extra limbs, no VFX or opponent. Readable preparation, full extension, retraction and recovery. Motion reference: Evolve University front push kick demonstration (teep), knee chamber -> hip push -> forward foot extension -> re-chamber.

ONE REAR HORIZONTAL ELBOW STRIKE, then recover. Begin in two-hand fighting guard, both feet planted. Fold the striking forearm tightly across the upper chest, keeping that arm visibly BENT rather than extending a fist. Twist hips and shoulders toward the target without changing the facing direction. Drive the pointed ELBOW horizontally across at upper-torso height. At contact the elbow tip must project beyond the torso silhouette; its hand stays tucked near the opposite upper chest. Opposite hand guards the cheek. Brief contact hold, then unwind the torso and return both hands to guard. Short heavy close-range strike, compact body, one elbow only. No straight punch, no downward chop, no full spin, no jump, no extra arms, no opponent and no VFX. Motion reference: Evolve MMA rear horizontal elbow demonstration, compact guard -> waist rotation -> outward bent elbow point -> guard recovery.

ONE grounded DOUBLE PALM THRUST, then recover. From compact fighting guard, draw BOTH OPEN tiger palms back beside the ribs at chest height with bent elbows. Sink weight briefly through bent knees. Push from the rear foot and shift weight into the front leg while extending BOTH arms FORWARD TOGETHER. At contact clearly show two open palms in front of the torso, palms facing outward, fingers upward, heels of the palms leading. Keep a slight bend in elbows; both hands must be visible, separate and the same size. Briefly hold the broad two-palm contact silhouette, then pull both hands back and return to the starting guard. One heavy double-palm strike only, feet stay grounded. No fists, no object or wall being pushed, no VFX, no opponent, no jumping, no extra hands or fingers, no full turn. Preserve the approved stocky tiger body and existing clothes. Motion reference: Shaolin Wahnam 'Fierce Tiger Pushes Mountain', rear-leg drive -> waist weight shift -> two palms extend forward together.

ONE low grounded SWEEPING LEG ATTACK, then recover. Start in compact fighting guard. Drop deeply onto ONE bent supporting leg, keeping that supporting foot on the ground. Extend the OTHER leg long and nearly straight outward, with the sweeping bare tiger foot clearly visible OUTSIDE the torso silhouette close to the ground. Rotate hips in a short low sweep arc across the front while the same supporting foot pivots in place. At the contact pose show a very LOW body, ONE deeply bent support knee, and ONE extended sweeping leg and foot unobscured by the body. Briefly hold that readable low horizontal leg contact. Re-fold the sweeping leg, rise and return to the initial guard. No airborne spin, no high kick, no second sweep, no extra legs, no opponent, no VFX. Keep head proportions and existing clothes consistent. Reference: Xing Long Kungfu School Wang Shifu Class 10 Sweep Kicks, low drop stance -> extended low sweeping leg -> compact recovery. Prioritize a visible low sweeping foot rather than hiding it behind the torso.

request.action_description: Perform ONE short HORIZONTAL ELBOW STRIKE with a clearly protruding elbow, then return to guard. Keep the striking arm folded into a sharp V: fist stays near its shoulder/chest, elbow points OUTSIDE the body. Brief preparation twists the hips away, then hips and torso turn only about a quarter turn toward the target. The bent ELBOW TIP swings forward horizontally at shoulder height and becomes the farthest-forward part of the arm at contact. Show this angular elbow tip clearly separated from the torso; do not extend the forearm or punch with a fist. The opposite hand stays at the cheek. Two feet remain grounded. Brief contact hold, then unwind and lower the elbow back into cheek-level guard. Head and clothing keep their approved identity. No complete spin or turning toward the camera in the back view, no downward chop, no jump, no VFX or opponent. Readable bent-arm elbow silhouette is essential.

elbowAlternative.reason: 첫 결과의 팔꿈치 돌출이 약해 두 번째 시도로 PixMiniMax를 비교 생성했다. 첫 결과를 보존하며 사용자 품질 검토를 기다린다.

qualityFindings.jab-ground-kick: 지지발은 고정되지만 원투와 킥의 전환에서 상체가 약 18~20px 이동한다. 연결 자세가 부족하다.
qualityFindings.horizontal-elbow: 첫 결과는 팔꿈치 돌출이 약하다. 두 번째 결과는 북동쪽이 앞모습으로 돌아가며 남동쪽 팔 윤곽에 큰 띠 모양이 생겼다. 두 결과 모두 최종 채택 전이다.
qualityFindings.double-palm: 남동쪽 두 손이 겹친다. 같은 구간의 역순으로 회수를 구성했다.
qualityFindings.visible-low-sweep: 공격 발이 몸 밖에 보이지만 낮추는 폭이 작고 두 방향 모두 화면 왼쪽으로 쓴다.
